limits: Callback IDs are joined only inside their exact raw route. Stage/worker/caller clocks and parent trees are preserved.
Wall overlap with a worker event is correlation. The worker event CPU duration is not clipped or assigned to the callback.
Parent clock-boundary residual subtracts direct children only. It is not scheduler time or an exclusive DSP cost.
Kernel identity comes from observed event and audio-owned slot records; pending identity remains unavailable.
Named logical byte counts are not measured hardware traffic.

every_deadline_miss_record: See root-produced native-deadline-misses.csv for every raw field across both allocations; all BAAB 291 misses are retained in the authenticated raw CSVs and independent verifier outputs.
interpretation_limits: All summaries retain their trial, mode, engine, channel, and phase. No pooled p50 or p99 across heterogeneous CAB routes is used.
BAAB A/B compare hooks compiled out with hooks compiled in; resource-enabled runs are separate. This is not the earlier QoS experiment or a proposed product fix.
CPU greater than wall is preserved. Wall minus CPU and parent-minus-direct-child residuals are not exact operating-system or virtualization delay.
Stage attribution locates observed intervals. An FFT or MAC stage outlier does not by itself demonstrate a convolution workload regression or justify a performance patch.
Kernel-swap scope entry is not kernel acceptance. Actual accept/reject/retire events and safe slot identities are separate; pending identity is unavailable in snapshots.
Worker overlap is descriptive. Worker and caller-main publications use separate CPU streams; whole-event worker CPU is not assigned to its overlapping callback window.
macOS resources have process_task_events scope, including workers. Minor/major fault splits and voluntary/involuntary switches remain explicitly unavailable, not zero.
Thread state is observed at two boundaries, not continuously. No hardware cache counters or memory residency guarantee are claimed.
Apple Virtual Machine 1 / Apple M1 (Virtual) is not physical-device audio-host evidence. AU, VST3, CoreAudio callbacks, DAW uninterrupted playback, and editor interaction remain NOT_EXECUTED.
Distinct allocations may produce distinct binary hashes. Within this allocation A and B are different binaries; no cross-allocation binary identity is assumed.
